page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading. It is provisioned with 96.0 GB of memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU core. The server includes no local NVMe or SSD storage and features no GPU acceleration, while delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a split between single-core throughput and multi-threaded scaling. Single-core evaluations reflect lower execution speeds, marked by a Geekbench single-core score of 942.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.06 GB/sec. However, multi-threaded performance reaches average benchmark tiers, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng result of 17646.71 and a PassMark CPU score of 18419.60. Memory operations deliver stable bandwidth, recording 90.83 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 53.0 GB/sec for writes.

The ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge instance balances processing capacity with memory availability, offering cost-effective resource density for parallelized tasks despite its legacy CPU hardware class. The lack of local disk storage requires reliance on network-attached volumes for persistent data. This server profile fits general-purpose application servers, static web serving (10.83 GB/sec throughput), Redis caching layers (16.93 million SET ops/sec), and enterprise database management systems.
